biocs.name: WmiPrvSe.exe Rare Child Command Line
biocs.description: Detection of WmiPrvSe.exe spawning a child process with an uncommon command line pattern
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'WmiPrvSe.exe'
| filter action_command_line not in ['\'powershell.exe -EncodedCommand ...\'', '\'cmd.exe /c ...\'']
| filter action_command_line contains 'WindowStyle Hidden'
